en: Zinzolin
You are an impressive Trainer to have come this far. Since you have gone to such trouble, let me show you something.
Under the great cannon, something huge stirred in the cold...
Zinzolin
The legendary Pokémon of ice! Its name is Kyurem. The missiles of ice we fired into Opelucid City were made with Kyurem's power and Team Plasma's science.
Well. You could become a threat to Team Plasma, so we shall be rid of you here.
{rival}
Not with me around, you won't! {player}, thanks for switching off the barrier. That was a big help!
Zinzolin
Hmph! Then we shall be rid of you both!
{rival}
I'm not losing to Team Plasma! ...What is this place, anyway?
That Pokémon... It's freezing just to look at. Was it the one that attacked Opelucid City?
Zinzolin
Hmph. You are cleverer than I thought. With that much sense, why sneak into our ship at all?
{rival}
Isn't it obvious? I'll do whatever it takes to get my sister's Pokémon back! Were you the one who stole a Purrloin in Aspertia City?
Zinzolin
If it was only a Purrloin, someone took it and is using it now. Why can't you see that? There are other Purrloin.
{rival}
That's the only Purrloin in the world that my grandpa caught for my little sister!
Zinzolin
One person's feelings. To you they matter a great deal. To everyone else, they are a trifle.
Ah. Kyurem has recovered completely. We shall put the DNA Splicers to good use. Shadow Triad, I leave these two to you.
{rival}
Don't mess with me! You're the one who lost!
Shadow Triad
There is a rush of wind, and the cold deck is gone from under your feet...
Zinzolin
Children have no business in this chamber.
Grunt
Don't get any closer to Kyurem!
